newsitem.title: GREECE: HELLENIC BANKING ASSN'S PANTELIAS GOES TO NATIONAL BANK.
newsitem.headline: HELLENIC BANKING ASSN'S PANTELIAS GOES TO NATIONAL BANK.

text.p: Spyros Pantelias, the economic consultant of the Hellenic Bank Association, joined state National Bank of Greece on March 1, market sources told Reuters.
Pantelias who holds a Ph.D in economics from Washington University at St Louis, Missouri. He was a former Reuters correspondent with the Greek National Service (GNN).
He will be a counselor to deputy National Bank governor Nickos Karamouzis, the sources said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
